display_information.name: super-t3
display_information.description: Your personal super-t3: turns your Slack messages into work for coding agents in T3 Code and reports back. It reads the channels it is in, but acts only for the person who set it up.

agent_view.agent_description: Your personal super-t3. Ask for work, follow it, and approve plans here; it acts only for you.

suggested_prompts.title: What's waiting for me?
suggested_prompts.message: What proposals and work are waiting for me?

suggested_prompts.title: Propose work from my channels
suggested_prompts.message: Read today's messages in the channels you watch and propose work worth doing.

suggested_prompts.title: What are my workers doing?
suggested_prompts.message: Summarize what my running workers are doing.
